description.en: A list of icp record entity IDs.

descriptions.zh:
传入ICP备案id列表，返回ICP备案详情。

如查签名接口（QuerySmsSignList/GetSmsSign）会查出ICP备案id，然后使用此接口进一步查询详情。
descriptions.en:
Pass a list of icp record IDs to retrieve their details.

For example, call the QuerySmsSignList or GetSmsSign API to obtain the required icp record IDs.
